rules.blocks: a topic family of two or more documents is a block; families of one document are paired within the split in descending similarity of their eligible-section text, ties by document name; a family left over is a block of its own
rules.cap: holdout: a section is passed over when its block holds four positions; development: none
rules.frame: sections of devset_sources.eligible_sections that no pilot case used as its seed or partner section
rules.order: blocks by the number of pilot cases they hold, then by SHA-256 of '<seed>:<split>:block:<block_id>'; sections of a block by SHA-256 of '<seed>:<split>:section:<source_id>:<char_start>'; round r takes the r-th section of every block that has one
rules.partner: the frame section of the other documents of the block most similar to the seed section, ties by document name and offset
rules.quota: development: 18 single-doc, 20 multi-doc, 10 aggregation and 12 needs-refusal/clarification of 60, less the classes of the 30 pilot cases; holdout: single-doc 24, multi-doc 40, aggregation 16 and needs-refusal/clarification 20 per cent of the positions the cap leaves room for — the sum over the blocks of the smaller of four and the frame sections of the block — by largest remainder, ties in the order of the sequence
rules.replacement: the order and the tests are applied to the state the first verification of the split left: a section that was the seed of any draft of the split, dropped drafts and earlier replacements included, is not taken; a pair of a section and its partner that any draft or earlier replacement used is the pair of an earlier position; the cap counts the confirmed drafts of a block and the replacements seated in it, not its dropped drafts; the partner is found by the partner rule among all frame sections of the other documents of the block
rules.sequence: position p takes the class with the largest quota * p - placed * total, ties in the order multi-doc, single-doc, aggregation, needs-refusal/clarification
rules.similarity: cosine of TF-IDF vectors, rounded to 9 decimals: tokens are runs of three or more letters, case-folded; idf = ln(documents / documents with the token) over the eligible-section text of every corpus document
rules.tests: single-doc and needs-refusal/clarification: every section; multi-doc: the block has another document with a frame section, and the pair of the section and its partner is the pair of no earlier position; aggregation: the multi-doc test, and the section holds three or more list items or table rows
